newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen lower at open, Greenspan to speak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen lower at open, Greenspan to speak.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open lower Wednesday as Wall Street once again trades in the shadow of testimony by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Grenspan.
Greenspan will deliver the second phase of his semiannual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony before Congress; the first part sent markets tumbling last week.

"The testimony will be the main focus of the day. Will he continue to pour cold water on the market?" said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "I think he will reiterate what he said last week."
